svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Judge grading style and self-preference, by judge and dimension
svg.desc: Dot and interval plot. Six judges on the vertical axis, four rubric dimensions as columns, grading style on the top row and self-preference on the bottom row. Filled dots mark 95 percent intervals that exclude zero.
svg.text: Every judge grades on a scale of its own, and most favor their own answers
Points on the 5-point rubric scale. Bars are 95% bootstrap intervals over the 60 questions.
Filled dot: the interval excludes zero. Hollow dot: the interval includes zero.
points above (+) or below (−) the other judges' median, on answers its own model did not write
the same deviation on its own answers, minus its grading style
Source: data/analysis_results.json (analyze v4, seed 20260521, 2000 bootstrap draws); 6455 valid grades of 6480.
